questions: I'd like to ask you about cooking. How often do you cook at home, and what do you usually make?
I see. Who taught you to cook, or how did you learn?
Interesting. Should schools teach every student how to cook? Why or why not?
Let's talk about music. What kind of music do you listen to most, and when do you listen to it?
I see. Tell me about a concert or a live performance that you remember.
Interesting. Do you think that streaming services are good or bad for musicians? Explain your answer.
I'd like to talk with you about friendship. How did you meet one of your closest friends?
I see. What makes a person a good friend, in your opinion?
Interesting. Is it easier or harder to make friends as an adult than as a child? Why?
Thanks. One last question. Can social media replace meeting friends in person? Explain your answer.
Let's talk about your hometown. What is the place where you grew up like?
I see. What would you show a visitor who had only one day there?
Interesting. How has your hometown changed in the last ten years?
I'd like to ask you about mobile phones. How many hours a day do you think you use your phone, and for what?
I see. Have you ever tried to spend a day without your phone? What happened?
Interesting. At what age should children get their first smartphone? Explain your answer.
Let's talk about reading. What was the last book that you read, and did you enjoy it?
I see. Do you prefer printed books or reading on a screen? Why?
Interesting. Why do you think fewer young people read books for fun today?
I'd like to talk with you about celebrations. What is the most important holiday in your family, and how do you celebrate it?
I see. Tell me about a celebration that did not go as planned.
Interesting. Are traditional celebrations becoming less important? Why or why not?
Let's talk about pets. Have you ever had a pet, or would you like to have one?
I see. What do people need to think about before they get a pet?
Interesting. Should pets be allowed in offices and university buildings? Explain your answer.
I'd like to ask you about work. What job would you like to have in ten years, and why?
I see. What is more important to you in a job, the salary or the people you work with?
Interesting. Many people now work from home. What are the good and bad sides of this?
Thanks. One last question. Will computers and robots do most jobs in the future? Explain your answer.
Let's talk about learning languages. Which languages do you speak, and how did you learn them?
I see. What is the hardest part of learning a new language for you?
Interesting. With translation apps getting better, is it still worth learning other languages? Why?
I'd like to talk with you about where people live. Would you rather live in a big city or in the countryside? Why?
I see. Tell me about a time that you spent in a very quiet place.
Interesting. Why do so many young people move to big cities, and is this a problem?
Let's talk about money. Did you get pocket money as a child, and what did you do with it?
I see. What is a good way for students to save money?
Interesting. Should schools teach students how to manage their money? Explain your answer.
I'd like to ask you about working in teams. Tell me about a group project that you were part of.
I see. What do you usually do in a team, lead or follow? Why?
Interesting. Is it fair when all members of a team get the same grade? Why or why not?
Let's talk about museums. When did you last visit a museum or a gallery, and what did you see?
I see. What could museums do to attract more young visitors?
Interesting. Should museums be free for everyone? Explain your answer.
I'd like to talk with you about the news. How do you usually find out what is happening in the world?
I see. How do you decide whether a news story is true?
Interesting. Do people today know more or less about the world than people fifty years ago? Why?
Let's talk about free time. What do you like to do on a free weekend?
I see. Tell me about a hobby that you started recently or would like to start.
Interesting. Do people today have more free time or less than in the past? Explain your answer.
Thanks. One last question. Is it important to have a hobby that has nothing to do with your work or studies? Why?
